```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a pairplot to visualize relationships between all numerical features,
# colored by species. This is highly insightful for the Iris dataset.
g = sns.pairplot(df, hue='species', diag_kind='kde', palette='viridis')

# Add a title to the figure
g.fig.suptitle('Pairwise Relationships of Iris Features by Species', y=1.02) # y adjusts title position

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
